facts.fact: The Ministry says a government-funded project connected ten council offices (Katesh, Uvinza, Wanging'ombe, Urambo, Kaliua, Mbulu, Monduli, Sikonge, Simanjiro and Kiteto) to the national backbone, June 2018 to April 2019.
The Ministry names ten councils connected to the national backbone in the 2018-2019 project, giving no total of councils.
